[edit&action=edit&section=34 "Edit section: Date")]

Since being fixed on the fourth Thursday in November by law in 1941 (from 1863 to 1940 it was on the last Thursday in November), the holiday in the United States can occur on any date from November 22 to 28 (November 24 to 30 from 1863 to 1940). When it falls on November 22 or 23, it is not the last Thursday, but the penultimate Thursday in November. Regardless, it is the Thursday preceding the last Saturday of November.
